seo.title: ODD — creative expertise, put to wider use
seo.description: ODD brings creative expertise into culture, business and society — through ODDfest, ODDference, ODDspace and Work with ODD, in Helsinki.

hero.mosaicAlt: A live photo mosaic from the ODDfest archive

opening.headline: ODD brings creative expertise into wider use — across culture, business and society.

whatOddIs.headline: More than one event.
whatOddIs.body: We build events, spaces and programmes where creative professionals, organisations and communities meet, learn from each other and make things together — ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace are three different doors into the same idea. Creative work gets stronger, and more useful to everyone else, when it has real structures to grow inside rather than one show a year: an open festival platform, a flagship business event, a year-round space, and a handful of ways to work with us directly.

twoWaysIn.intro: Business and creative professionals don't usually meet as equals. ODD is built so both sides bring something the other needs.

business.body: Creative professionals think about uncertainty, culture, attention and meaning for a living — knowledge that's directly useful to how you lead, build and communicate. ODDference puts that expertise on the agenda; Work with ODD gets you closer to it year-round.

creative.body: A place to show your work, meet people outside your usual circle, and build something that outlasts one production. ODDfest gives your programme a wider stage; ODDspace gives you somewhere to work between events.

whatsHappening.note: A running list of what's on across ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace — updated as things are confirmed.

items.title: Coffee on the House
items.description: A standing open meetup for ODDspace members and friends, most weeks, in Vallila.

platforms.title: ODDfest
platforms.body: An open, distributed creative platform across Helsinki — independent artists, collectives, venues and organisations hosting their own programme under one shared identity, building on the Creative Week model piloted in 2026.

platforms.title: ODDference
platforms.body: ODD's flagship professional event: a day built entirely around what business and the rest of society can learn from creative expertise.

platforms.title: ODDspace
platforms.body: A year-round base in Vallila where creative professionals and the organisations working with them meet, work and build things between events.

platforms.title: Work with ODD
platforms.body: Membership, agency projects and partnerships — the ways an organisation builds an ongoing relationship with ODD.

workWithOdd.title: Several ways to work with ODD.
workWithOdd.intro: Every organisation starts somewhere different — a ticket, a project, a standing relationship. These are the four ways in.
